name: Rayzher
summary: Rayzher Industrial Co., Ltd. provides engineering and design planning services throughout Taiwan and China. Its core competencies include the comprehensive design, planning, and construction of major plant systems, as well as the installation and intricate secondary configuration of all types of factory equipment. Beyond services, Rayzher also manufactures and supplies its own factory equipment and a range of consumables. The firm is additionally involved in the fabrication and setup of specialized gas supply systems. Furthermore, it handles the global import and export of essential instruments, materials, and components specifically for semiconductor equipment. Established in 1996, Rayzher's headquarters are situated in Zhubei, Taiwan.
